classification: Exploratory reused-outcome diagnostic after the logit-only cubic lead; not primary confirmation or rescue
scope: Apply the same fixed cubic Taylor formula to every recorded activation/memory field; no new fitting or probe selection
third_derivative: For each field, [first(+h)+first(-h)-2*first(0)]/h^2, using only frozen coarse/fine steps
numerical_gate: Each original state group must have coarse/fine third-derivative discrepancy <=max(10% of fine third norm,1e-6); keep every failure visible
comparison: Same96 known endpoints, same original group and resolved-field definitions; report weak/strong held errors and per-context numerical validation
preservation: Do not change native archives, original second-order predictions, primary failures, direction or semantic claims. A fresh prospective test remains required.
